                            <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" width="100%" style="background-color: #F8FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #FF9900; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-left-width: 4px;">
                                <tr>
                                    <td style="padding: 20px 24px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.7em; text-align: justify;">
                                        <div style='margin-top:2px; margin-bottom:6px; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; color:#0F172A; letter-spacing:-0.3px;'>1. 수도권 서부 AI 인프라 대규모 수주와 북미 분산 발전엔진 공급망 진입</div>수도권 송전망 포화 속에서도 서부권을 중심으로 초대형 AI 데이터센터 신축 및 운영 수주가 집중됨. 현대엔지니어링이 인천 원창동에 8,700억 원 규모의 50MW급 데이터센터 신축 사업을 수주하며 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5VRWp1Z3lUejE0clVpNDQxUFdweXNqTV9GQzdaTnRQUkNWRDl1MTcwR3RkUHBrOUZpU21xWE50bDlUdUpMVkdMZFlOa0tyc0ZCSFJveFFxajQ5UQ?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[1]</a> 시공 역량을 입증함 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE9NQ0Q0bWd1cV93YS1fd1NiVzdHSFRhYWZxWUp3TTRESDhtQXdoRUllWUI4cnpTOFJnWjV4djQ1b0VkQUhyd3FDOXlIS0o0N0NaNFM1Y19DMzJHdUo0MDlwYQ?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[2]</a>. KT클라우드는 인천 청라 50MW급 AI 데이터센터 사업에 DBO 파트너로 참여해 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE5wR3RzNVlXN0NsUU1WYzRheUhmVFBCcEZEVmt6SGNyTHRLdlI1ZUNCVkNBT2tPcG9UUkJpaFJieEk4cVZjdnYzOWNqR3Rkc0NlU3ZDTFhHMVI1QzTSAWBBVV95cUxNZVdkQVBhUlU3LWdMZ1cwd1RDZVBQa1Rrd2JDVkRSdFlKZUNhZXp6N1hUYlhyc1c3M1d0bjBjblVRakRPUkMzek9aRVNGZWQ5U2Y2emE1M1Q4VVp6dVdldTc?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[3]</a> 수도권 서부 컴퓨팅 거점 확장을 가속화함 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE1VUUpja0RtWnEzdlB0Z0Q4eVpZYkJDeE82WldrNGJOMUhXVTFCbm9MWENSWXVsckJFR09YdmVwNXlNaW0tWkJKYzJXSTgwSXRzeFdTVFp3TTNhakgwS1Jrb1dTa09SN01aVHgyaHRsMkVfS3M?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[5]</a> 3,900억 원(약 2억 7,600만 달러) 규모를 수주하며 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFBueXhVMW02SXA4MW9WdUdiUkZrVFpzNktkSUt6V29TN0c1d25GTFNUamg5OXFsUElEZE82V1dRXy1IZnBqSFpseGJNMjZSNjZwa2F6bHRiRVVKMGF5eHZCRVNVSS0zdVJTazdR?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[6]</a> 북미 전력 시장 직수출을 열었음 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxORUZvZkRld1diU3NJejhmXzkxbTZqRF94OTZjS2VreGpXcnd1NmoyekVfeDdDcmRpdnZKd1NBXzZBWmNvVVNGMURIbkx2XzlGcmI5Z0syNVZOamtqNlhKeXRPS3VYM2hZNmdIemlnMmVIQzJ5QmxFcUJIVzBzSXhhOXlsaXFNSmFIUHJ1VC1qaUVSSG9mU1JLODlOcXEwdDVJNlE?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[7]</a>. 모회사 HD현대 역시 컨트롤타워를 개편해 데이터센터 엔진 부문을 재편하고 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE1ETXJXNTY5bjhUYUpjLVVkekdMdzNwRGYzemU5VEhGZ1k5N0Y0Y3ozX18wZ0RhaGlHWFpHYjgyT2FqWW9qMGRqTWtMU29IdG9HSVNya3ZDNHZPS0UydjJhek1laW8?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[8]</a> SMR을 핵심 성장축으로 전진 배치함 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1xZzBFc3lXQUtfcTZndFlkVW1QU2VORjBjOFVsSnRCa0VvWVBiT3A2QmY2b3AyTjBodlRvczZBdXgzOVNlVE1OQ1BQQlFReFU?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[9]</a>. 한편 미국 오클라호마시티 데이터센터 캠퍼스도 독립형 오프그리드 발전소 투자를 확정하는 등 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxOckItWE8wRFdTamhDek9wbUtJaURnM3JKMHN4VW5mSTdYT1R4UjI1Tno3bjFwblN3YzlRaUxPQmV2bE9sckcwUW5sUmFjTm93Z3ZOVTI5d0RBbUVfVnpmYU0xY2FqaElWUmNNR3A2cFRIemNKN0M2RndBeFZZSXc5TFJOT2NLLU51MVRlVTk2YnVsN0hRdGFHdDN2d0ZOTDdTWkRTVVpB?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[10]</a> 전력망을 건너뛰는 온사이트 자가발전이 필수 대안으로 안착함.<div style='margin-top:18px; margin-bottom:6px; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; color:#0F172A; letter-spacing:-0.3px;'>2. 글로벌 데이터센터 모라토리엄 확산과 인허가 물리적 충돌 및 환경 규제</div>전력망 과부하와 환경 파괴 우려로 글로벌 데이터센터 인허가 중단이 잇따름. AI 본산인 샌프란시스코와 오클랜드 시의회가 신규 데이터센터 승인을 45일간 중단하는 모라토리엄을 가결하고 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE93OTVsZGFTQnhPZktnekk3Y1ZUenhDZzRSUEVfR3FlcUJEU3lwdmI3ZnR4MUdVZERqSmpFMnJCNkVBbWlxTm50dWVaUFF0RHVoekQzOTRzS0pTV1BhUGdhOTJEVXhad2JkdTlENkVtNS0?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[11]</a> 조례 정비에 착수함 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQZVk5MmVNVGZpLTF0OEV0NHU5OFdtNGFjZUFpSVRaWnBZYVc4Yno5NTBja1kxc0t1SUZqQVZCaVMtSDF2WW92elBJclkzNjVNdXZ5TEdTM0U3bE5NcDdpQ1pQSFVZbmxlUm9WM09lTmw0d09mMXhtWk9pUnUteXMtbHc1Q2VQWTMxZUNFSW1zcDRMUk1UVlMzb2NtOXB6TTlkS0ptV2ttZGNWOC1WTzFFa0l3?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[12]</a>. 테네시주 멤피스에서는 xAI 증설 반대 모라토리엄 표결이 연기되자 <a href='https://news.google.?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[14]</a>. 펜실베이니아주 주민 수백 명도 주 의사당에서 모라토리엄을 요구하는 대규모 시위를 벌였고 <a href='https://www.google.com/search?q=Hundreds Of Protesters Tell Governor Shapiro, Legislators, “We Won’t Back Down;” Call For Data Center Moratorium&tbm=nws' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7; background-color:#E0F2FE; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:1px 5px; margin:0 2px; text-decoration:none;'>[15]</a> 주의회에 모라토리엄 입법을 공식 청원함 <a href='https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNeFhqclpzTUJQRkNoQ1NyZ3I4STFHSHBpOGk3T2FEX0FfZ3phRDc3WGdqc3plX3NvQlgwMnZiZzgycDhoLXpRLTlsbTUwRHdtcWdxUkJiRXRNWFllZUQ5c3FUOEV1N0FmUFhOZG5ERHRnLURvb2VwQlhtMmVMWjY2alh0R3pUUng3N3lhZGxKVXZRbGdEaFpELW9VYXdxbmlXUFVj?oc=5' target='_blank' style='color:#0284C7;
